      "originalRequirement": "A user can add a non-empty task and immediately see it on the board. The same task must survive a page reload. Empty and whitespace-only task names must show a clear validation message without creating a task.",
      "fingerprint": "9c1f3dcf7fd3f279",
      "createdAt": "2026-09-26T00:00:00.000Z",
      "criteria": [
        {
          "id": "SHIP-01",
          "title": "A new task appears on the board",
          "description": "Enter a unique task name, submit it, and check the actual task list.",
          "requirementRef": "A user can add a non-empty task and immediately see it on the board.",
          "expectedBehavior": "The newly added task is visible in the task list, not just in the input field.",
          "contextMode": "fresh",
          "steps": [
            {
              "id": "SHIP-01-S1",
              "type": "navigate",
              "url": "{{TARGET_URL}}",
              "description": "Open the Shipboard application"
            },
            {
              "id": "SHIP-01-S2",
              "type": "fill",
              "locator": "Task name",
              "value": "{{UNIQUE_CONTENT}}",
              "description": "Enter this run's unique task name"
            },
            {
              "id": "SHIP-01-S3",
              "type": "click",
              "locator": "Add task",
              "description": "Add the task to the board"
            },
            {
              "id": "SHIP-01-S4",
              "type": "assertVisibleIn",
              "locator": "#taskList",
              "value": "{{UNIQUE_CONTENT}}",
              "description": "Verify the new task is visible in the task list"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "SHIP-02",
          "title": "The same task survives a reload",
          "description": "Continue in the same browser as SHIP-01, reload, and check the same task.",
          "requirementRef": "The same task must survive a page reload.",
          "expectedBehavior": "Reloading the page keeps the task that was just added.",
          "dependsOn": [
            "SHIP-01"
          ],
          "contextMode": "inherit",
          "steps": [
            {
              "id": "SHIP-02-S1",
              "type": "reload",
              "description": "Reload the same browser page"
            },
            {
              "id": "SHIP-02-S2",
              "type": "assertVisibleIn",
              "locator": "#taskList",
              "value": "{{UNIQUE_CONTENT}}",
              "description": "Verify the same task is still on the board"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "SHIP-03",
          "title": "Blank task names are rejected",
          "description": "Use an independent browser to check empty and whitespace-only submissions.",
          "requirementRef": "Empty and whitespace-only task names must show a clear validation message without creating a task.",
          "expectedBehavior": "The board remains empty and displays an actionable validation message.",
          "contextMode": "fresh",
          "steps": [
            {
              "id": "SHIP-03-S1",
              "type": "navigate",
              "url": "{{TARGET_URL}}",
              "description": "Open a fresh Shipboard browser session"
            },
            {
              "id": "SHIP-03-S2",
              "type": "assertCount",
              "locator": ".task-item",
              "expected": 0,
              "description": "Verify the fresh board has no tasks"
            },
            {
              "id": "SHIP-03-S3",
              "type": "fill",
              "locator": "Task name",
              "value": "",
              "description": "Leave the task name empty"
            },
            {
              "id": "SHIP-03-S4",
              "type": "click",
              "locator": "Add task",
              "description": "Try to add an empty task"
            },
            {
              "id": "SHIP-03-S5",
              "type": "assertVisible",
              "value": "Add a task name before continuing.",
              "description": "Verify an actionable validation message appears"
            },
            {
              "id": "SHIP-03-S6",
              "type": "assertCount",
              "locator": ".task-item",
              "expected": 0,
              "description": "Verify no empty task was created"
            },
            {
              "id": "SHIP-03-S7",
              "type": "fill",
              "locator": "Task name",
              "value": "   ",
              "description": "Enter a whitespace-only task name"
            },
            {
              "id": "SHIP-03-S8",
              "type": "click",
              "locator": "Add task",
              "description": "Try to add a whitespace-only task"
            },
            {
              "id": "SHIP-03-S9",
              "type": "assertVisible",
              "value": "Add a task name before continuing.",
              "description": "Verify whitespace also produces a validation message"
            },
            {
              "id": "SHIP-03-S10",
              "type": "assertCount",
              "locator": ".task-item",
              "expected": 0,
              "description": "Verify the task board is still empty"
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
